Author: Grimmortal Dread
Name: CamCam
Punchline: Replace the AFK idle camera with your own cinematic shots.
Description: When you go idle, CamCam films you, your target, or nearby players with camera shots you design: angles, pans, dolly moves, recorded Free Fly paths, transitions, FOV and more. Includes a numpad Free Fly camera. Open settings with /camcam.
